name: Raoa Addons for Elementor
author: raoatech

sections.description:
Raoa Addons for Elementor is a lightweight and performance-focused addon pack containing free Elementor widgets. Build navigation menus, breadcrumb trails, post grids, Swiper-powered post carousels, testimonials, team sections, tabs, counters, and animated text without unnecessary frontend overhead.

Available Widgets

  • Menu – Build flexible navigation layouts with Elementor controls.
  • Breadcrumb – Display an automatically generated breadcrumb trail in two styles.
  • Split Tabs – Organize content in clean, interactive tab sections.
  • Posts – Display posts in responsive grids with numbered and previous/next pagination.
  • Posts Carousel – Present posts using a responsive Swiper carousel with navigation, pagination, autoplay, and loop controls.
  • Year Counter – Display dynamic year values automatically.
  • Text Slider – Create lightweight animated text effects.
  • Testimonials – Showcase customer feedback in four display styles.
  • Team – Present team members, social links, profile details, alignment, and responsive spacing controls in four styles.

Features

  • Nine free Elementor widgets
  • Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile controls
  • Conditional style controls that only appear when relevant
  • Swiper 12 carousel integration
  • Reusable carousel navigation and pagination controls
  • Standard WordPress post pagination
  • Multiple post, testimonial, breadcrumb, and team layouts
  • Translation-ready and WordPress coding-standard-friendly output
  • Lightweight, maintainable, and developer-friendly architecture
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/raoa-addons-for-elementor directory, or install via WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Open Elementor and use the widgets.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Will this plugin affect site speed?

No. The plugin is designed with performance as a priority.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Added Breadcrumb, Posts Carousel, Testimonials, and Team widgets.
  • Added two Breadcrumb layouts with conditional style controls.
  • Added reusable Swiper 12 carousel navigation, pagination, autoplay, loop, speed, and responsive gap controls.
  • Added standard numbered and previous/next pagination to the Posts widget.
  • Added component-specific Posts and Posts Carousel style sections.
  • Added responsive Team content alignment and element spacing controls.
  • Improved translation, escaping, responsive controls, and WordPress.org compatibility.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Add Menu, Split Tabs, Posts, Year Counter, and Text Slider widgets.
